_doc: Bird flocks (ADR-0027, WildlifeDef kind flock): drawn as instances, they flush when you or a Hollowed come close or at a loud noise, and a flush is a sound the Hollowed hear (flush_loudness m): birds give your position away. Crows circle what flushed them, calling, before they settle. A crow flock you flush may become a Murmur (ADR-0034, `murmur`): chance (bloom_chance where the Bloom is strong) from gamestage_min; it follows you at height m in a ring of radius m, and every caw (seconds apart) is a sound of mark_loudness m on you; it loses you after cover_seconds under a roof or trees, scatters at a gunshot or explosion within scatter_radius m, roosts at nightfall and gives up after max_seconds.
